title: NGC 604 (NIRCam image)
caption: The star-forming region NGC 604 in the Triangulum Galaxy, imaged by the James Webb Space Telescope
celestial: NGC 604 · constellation Triangulum · about 3 million light-years away (source figure)

recognition.text: Ranked #77 on ESA/Webb’s published “Top 100 Images” list (an institutional selection, not an audience score).

story: Clumpy red clouds with filament-like strands fill the centre of this frame. On their centre-right is a large, cavernous bubble holding a hazy blue glow sprinkled with stars, its rim edged in white dust, and smaller bubbles sit near the top. This is NGC 604, a star-forming region in the Triangulum Galaxy, a neighbouring galaxy also known as M33.

The hollows are the work of bright, hot young stars, whose winds blow cavities in the surrounding gas and dust. Webb's infrared camera sorts that material by type. Bright orange streaks mark carbon-based molecules called polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons, or PAHs.

Farther from the cavities, deeper red traces molecular hydrogen, cooler gas that is a prime place for new stars to form. Hydrogen that has been ionised by ultraviolet radiation shows up as the ghostly white and blue glow.
scale: Using the source's listed field of view (2.16 x 1.76 arcminutes) and distance (3 million light years), the frame spans roughly 1,900 × 1,500 light-years. Its light set out about 3 million years before reaching the telescope.

understand.summary: This is a near-infrared image from Webb's NIRCam, with the shortest filters shown in blue and cyan, a middle band in green, a PAH filter in yellow and the longest filters, including molecular hydrogen, in red.
understand.eye: Almost all of this light is infrared and invisible to the eye. The colours are assigned to separate the different kinds of gas and dust.

explore: NGC 604 lies 2.73 million light-years from Earth. It offers astronomers a nearby place to examine a dense concentration of very young, massive stars. A few disc-shaped background galaxies and some small red stars are scattered around the image.
alt: Clumpy red filamentary clouds on black, with a large bubble at centre-right containing a blue glow with stars and white dust at its edges, and smaller bubbles near the top.
